articles.title: Big Footprints Point to a Giant Mammal in Dinosaur Times
articles.summary: Fossil footprints in Brazil point to a cougar-size mammal that lived among dinosaurs, adding to clues that some early mammals grew surprisingly large.

articles.title: Why Bitter Coffee Starts to Taste Better
articles.summary: UC San Francisco scientists found a slow dopamine pathway from the gut to the brain that teaches us to like bitter flavors such as coffee over time.

articles.title: NASA's Big Plan: Build a Moon Base by 2032
articles.summary: NASA will spend up to $10 billion on new moon deals, including a nuclear-powered rover called PROMISE, on the way to a lasting moon base by 2032.
